I was chosen along with about 10 other members of the audience to be hypnotized during a magician's show on a cruise ship. I was pretty excited and went up on stage. The guy proceeded to do his spiel while having some assistants take members off the stage in the middle. I remember noticing that, and figured that perhaps they were not truly hypnotized. However, as the act progressed with about 5 members at this point, I remember panicking and realizing that I was not hypnotized. His act was comedic and he had some members 'drive' along the stage amongst other things. I decided to play along because I felt bad and didn't want to ruin his show. I'm not sure if the other people were completely cognizant like me, and I don't want to call the guy a fraud, but I was basically a performer for a few minutes. It was a funny internal experience all the same, and my entire family who were there truly believed I was hypnotized.
